name: Inline Lyrics
author: cloudsurfer
description: Synced lyrics in the bar, with explicit MPRIS player filtering.

barWidget.description: Requires the bundled, locally built lrcsnc backend.

schema.label: Allowed players
schema.description: Comma-separated, case-sensitive MPRIS name fragments. Empty allows any player not ignored. No fallback outside this list.

schema.label: Ignored players
schema.description: Comma-separated MPRIS name fragments. Ignores take precedence. Websites usually share the browser identity.
